args.common: ROUND 3 of the water work (overnight 22-23 Nov 2026, launched by the lead; the client is asleep and said 'fulll powerrrrr'; no questions to the client tonight; nothing merges into MAIN). CLIENT'S WORDS (verbatim, 22 Nov): (1) 'cek flicker tulil.mov, ITUU GOBLOG' = desktop: blocky dark shapes along the left ice sheets' waterline reflections, much worse while the camera moves; (2) 'gila, itu reflection yang bongkahan es belakang kek kontol banget, vertical line gitu doang anjing, kasar banget' = the far ice chunks' reflections are rough, flat vertical lines; (3) 'cek bibir air jelek.mov, bagian situ juga anjing jelek bangetttt refleksi air dan tepi bongkahan es nyaa' = the water lip and the ice edges at the far slabs. Client videos: MAIN/flicker tulil.mov and MAIN/bibir air jelek.mov (look at them). The client's machine is a base Apple M4 = T1 on a DPR 2 display. Standing words: 'please make no mistakes', awwwards site-of-the-day level. HISTORY: round 1 = LANES/p4wl (:5163, P4WL_BAND); round 2 = LANES/wl2 (:5167) = p4wl + wl2g (the walk anchored in lake space: the shelf contour no longer reshapes) + its fix round. Read the round-2 reports in MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4wl2/ (judge_wl2b, judge_wl2, the fixer's LOG / HANDOFF in LANES/wl2/HANDOFF.md, rejudge_wl2). ROUND 2 RESULT (re-judge 22:52, pass = false; read MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4wl2/rejudge_wl2/LOG.md): complaint 1: the shelf contour no longer reshapes (wl2g's lake-anchored taps). The fixer's WL2FJ (P4WL_BAND's share from a band-limited bump, ?wl2fj=0) removed most of the real-loop regression. But the water in front of the left ice sheets still pops about 10 % more than MAIN in the dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2: dt 28-34 MAIN 339 | wl2 376, every wl2 run above every MAIN run; T2 +7 %, T1 DPR 1 +8 to +23 % (WL2-RJ1 major). WL2FJ also put the stepped left box back to MAIN's level (DPR 2 1053 -> 1262) and the stepped far box at +8 % vs :5163 (1586 -> 1729). The shelf outline is still a static, hard quarter-texel staircase; the GT is soft (WL2-FJ5 minor). Complaints 2 and 3 are untouched: short soft columns, stepped lips that crawl. wl2 scores = MAIN on all five lenses. BASE FOR ROUND 3: LANES/wl2 (lab :5167), FROZEN. TOOLS: round 1-2 tools in $SP/work_p4/p4wl/tools (cap.mjs, gtpop.py [the box as 4 numbers], idchain2.sh, perfab.mjs, perf2.sh, rl.mjs, slabcrop.py, sbs.py, mkvid.py) plus the round-2 judges' tools: cols.py / colmatch.py (column length / excess vs REF) in $SP/work_p4/judge_wl2b/tools, the dt-controlled real loop rl.mjs setup in $SP/work_p4/judge_wl2. THE BAR, every item on your FINAL build: (1) Complaint 1: in the dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2 (1512x860 or 1440x766, pointer circling, n >= 100 frames per frame-time band, region CSS 0-480 x 440-620 and the left water CSS 0-160), the lane does not pop more than MAIN (:5162), and the left shelf contour stays stable (same-pose sheet, look). (2) Complaint 2: the far columns move toward ref_F000 (REF median length 82 px / excess 22.3 at T1 rest by cols.py; MAIN 50 / 16.2): longer and brighter, broken by ripples like REF, never coarse bars or 1-px scanlines; far-box blips <= GT; the x ~1208 column not dimmer than MAIN. (3) Complaint 3: the slab-foot lips have no tooth / step in a 4x same-pose sheet MAIN | base | lane | GT, and no crawl in the real loop at T1 DPR 2 (lip band CSS 860-1440 x 420-600). (4) T1 pointer sweep <= +5 % vs :5162 with >= 8 interleaved STRICT pairs (report the paired median and both modes; identical code is bimodal). (5) No new sparkle at 60 fps; the FAIR gate on all six paths vs each build's own 16-sample GT. (6) Your switch ?<lane>=0 IDENTICAL to :5167 and ?p4wl=0 IDENTICAL to :5162 (ident at T1, T2, T0 phone, p04 / p06 / p07). (7) The ice rings' look unchanged (the client's decision); T0 phones unchanged unless proven better; tsc clean in both configs; 0 console errors. CLIENT FILES: REF | MAIN | lane crops at 1x / 2x and a short mp4 at T1 DPR 2 (MAIN left, lane right) into MAIN/notes/round11/refs_user/wl3_<lane>_*. Short dated LOG entries; delete capture sets once analysed (disk: keep < 3 GB per WORK); never start a heavy job outside the slot ($SP/slot/slot.mjs); self-gate before ok = true.

wl3b.build: LANE wl3b (lab :5168): JOB B = the client's complaints 2 and 3, on top of the frozen base wl2. Round 2's lane wl2b failed on exactly this; read judge_wl2b first (lane_backup/p4wl2/judge_wl2b/). COLUMNS: re-test the length / brightness scale (K about 2.6 on sE for the faces' share only) WITH a distance-limited face cap: 8 faces only where the early stop causes the left-shelf pops (near / left water, below about 25 m), 4 beyond the D0..D1 ramp. Alternatively, after the 4th face give the remainder share to the brighter target. Round 2's cap 8 dimmed the x ~1208 column: T1 61 -> 34 px. Break the columns like REF: measure REF's break spacing / contrast first, then use the pixel's own mip-filtered lake_chop slope at that frequency, band-limited by screen derivatives. Round 2's breaks gave coarse bars (gain 2.5-5) or 1-px scanlines (T10): avoid both and show the look at 2x and in motion. LIPS: the root cause per judge_wl2b is that the face horizon tN is sampled at d + cL*{0.25, 0.75, 1.5, 3}, anchored to the max-mip cell entry d (1.25 m cells beyond 30 m), so the outline steps with the cells. Make tN continuous in P: anchor the samples to the face crossing found by bisection, or to the level-0 lake grid. A bilinear footprint height or a distance field at the slab feet is the other option. Prove it with 4x same-pose sheets of the slab feet MAIN | wl2 | lane | GT and the real loop at T1 DPR 2. Own the far-column share / cap, the breaks and the lips' tN sampling; if lane wl3a runs, it owns P4WL_BAND's per-pixel share (sE / mu): stay out of those hunks and say exactly what you changed. Switch ?wl3b=0 = :5167 exactly.
wl3b.judge: Judge lane wl3b against complaints 2 and 3 and THE BAR. Show REF | MAIN | wl2 | lane crops at 1x / 2x at rest and in motion (T1, T2). Give column length / excess by cols.py and colmatch.py vs REF, including the x ~1208 column; far-box blips vs GT; 4x same-pose lip sheets with the GT; the real loop at T1 DPR 2 on the lip band; complaint 1 must not get worse (left water in the real loop vs :5167 and MAIN). Your own perf A/B (>= 8 pairs), ident, sparkle, FAIR on at least the fast and reverse paths. LENSES: environment, color_grade_post, glitch_cursor_orbit, awwwards_jury.

wl3a.build: LANE wl3a (lab :5169): complaint 1 is still open after round 2 (see ROUND 2 RESULT above): fix it on top of the frozen base wl2. In the dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2, the water in front of the left ice sheets still pops about 10 % more than MAIN after round 2's WL2FJ fix (it was +66 to +106 %, from round 1's P4WL_BAND per-pixel share). WL2FJ also cost the stepped left / far boxes. GOAL: left water <= MAIN in the real loop at T1 DPR 2 / DPR 1 / T2, the stepped far box <= :5163 again, the contour stable, and if possible a softer outline instead of the hard staircase (WL2-FJ5). Keep wl2g's lake-anchored taps (the contour is stable). Band-limit the band's per-pixel share at its source: widen sE by the footprint of the pixel's own reflected elevation, for example sE' = sqrt(sE^2 + (k * fwidth(mu))^2); and/or take mu for the share from a pre-filtered (mip-biased) ripple normal; or fade toward MAIN's interpolated quarter share where no footprint mark is present. Root-cause it first with a bisection (which term pops). Prove it with the same dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2 (n >= 100 per band, left water <= MAIN), plus T1 DPR 1 and T2, a MAIN | lane strip, the same-pose shelf sheet (the contour must stay stable) and FAIR on all six paths. Own P4WL_BAND's per-pixel share (sE / mu); lane wl3b owns the far-column cap / breaks / lips. Switch ?wl3a=0 = :5167 exactly.
wl3a.judge: Judge lane wl3a against complaint 1 and THE BAR. Run the dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2 yourself: alternate MAIN and lane runs, n >= 100 per frame-time band, left water and the full left region; add T1 DPR 1 and T2. Show the same-pose shelf sheet MAIN | wl2 | lane | GT (the contour must stay stable), your own perf A/B (>= 8 pairs), ident, sparkle and FAIR on at least the fast and reverse paths, and anything worse anywhere. LENSES: glitch_cursor_orbit, environment, glitch_hold_sweep, awwwards_jury.

args.integrate: INTEGRATOR: create lane LANES/wl3 as an APFS clone of LANES/wl2 (cp -c -R), lab :5170. Take each round-3 lane whose judge passed, or whose open findings are minor or nit only. A lane with an open blocker or major stays out, unless its judge found the client's complaint fixed and the open major is pre-existing in MAIN: then take it and list the findings. Merge the taken lanes 3-way onto wl2 (base = LANES/wl2), keeping each switch (?wl3a=0, ?wl3b=0). All switches off must equal :5167 exactly, and ?p4wl=0 must equal :5162. THEN, on the merged build, run THE BAR in full: the real loop at T1 DPR 2 for complaints 1 and 3, the column numbers and crops for complaint 2, perf (>= 8 pairs), FAIR on all six paths, sparkle, ident and tsc. Write the client files refs_user/wl3_merged_* (REF | MAIN | merged at 1x / 2x, plus the mp4 at T1 DPR 2) and the patch vs LANES/p4ph/retrux-web/app (= what would merge into MAIN). ok = false if any item of THE BAR fails (say which). If nothing qualifies, take nothing (changed = false) and say why.
args.final_judge: FINAL JUDGE of the integration lane wl3 (:5170). The client's three complaints decide; for each, state FIXED / BETTER / SAME / WORSE vs MAIN (:5162) with numbers and images: (1) the desktop flicker at the left ice sheets while the camera moves, by the dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2 (the client's Mac) plus T1 DPR 1 and T2, with the shelf contour sheet; (2) the far ice chunks' reflections: not rough vertical lines, like ref_F000 (cols.py numbers, REF crops); (3) the water lip and the ice edges at the far slabs (4x same-pose sheet with the GT, real loop). Then THE BAR (4)-(7). Is it ready to show the client and merge into MAIN? LENSES: environment, glitch_cursor_orbit, glitch_hold_sweep, color_grade_post, awwwards_jury.
args.fix3c: ROUND 3c (lead, 23 Nov 05:58; round 3 ended with nothing merged: read MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4wl3/judge_wl3a/LOG.md and judge_wl3b/LOG.md). GOAL: make lane LANES/wl3a (lab :5169) a mergeable fix for complaint 1. Its judge found the left water at T1 DPR 2 14-23 % BELOW MAIN in the dt-matched real loop, and the contour stable and softer. Two majors block the merge: (1) WL3A-J1: part (W), the walk-pass share gate going from 0.002 to 0, shortens the far column at x ~1334 at T1 rest (67 -> 44 px; far median 48 -> 41), the opposite of complaint 2. Distance-limit (W): gate 0 only where the near / left water needs it (below about 25 m), 0.002 beyond. Or default it off if (E)+(S) alone keep the left water <= MAIN. Prove it with cols.py: x ~1334 back to >= 67 px, median >= 48, and the left water still <= MAIN in the dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2 (alternate MAIN / lane >= 4 times each, n >= 100 per band). (2) WL3A-J2: perf. You have the machine ALONE now (no other lane runs): >= 8 valid STRICT pairs vs :5162 on the T1 pointer sweep, plus the rest; the bar is <= +5 %. If it is over, find the cost with the W / E / S sub-switches and cut it. Then re-run ident (?wl3a=0 == :5167, ?p4wl=0 == :5162 at T1 / T2 / T0 phone / p04 / p06 / p07), FAIR fast + reverse at least, the 60 fps sparkle, T0 identical and tsc. Client files: refs_user/wl3c_* (an mp4 at T1 DPR 2, MAIN left and lane right; left-water strips; the far-column crop REF | MAIN | lane). Patch vs LANES/p4ph/retrux-web/app (= what would merge into MAIN: the whole stack p4wl + wl2g + WL2FJ + wl3a) into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4wl3c/. Self-gate; ok = true only if every item passes. Do not touch wl3b's ideas: complaints 2 and 3 come later.
args.judge3c: Judge LANES/wl3a after the round-3c fix (lab :5169) AS THE COMPLAINT-1 RELEASE CANDIDATE (the whole stack vs MAIN :5162 is what would merge). Check: complaint 1 in the dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2, alternated MAIN / lane, n >= 100 per band (left water and the left region <= MAIN, ideally better), plus T1 DPR 1 and T2; the shelf contour sheet; the far column at x ~1334 restored (cols.py vs MAIN / REF); perf <= +5 % (>= 8 valid STRICT pairs, yourself, machine alone); FAIR fast + reverse; sparkle; ident; T0; the ice untouched; anything worse than MAIN anywhere (rest look 1x / 2x, hold sweep, far water). Is it mergeable? LENSES: glitch_cursor_orbit, environment, glitch_hold_sweep, color_grade_post, awwwards_jury.
